_note: Every real project, superset of the resume variants. select_content picks the best subset per JD. Nothing here may be invented; tailoring may reword only.

projects.name: Retail Sales Analytics — SQL + Dashboard
bullets: Cleaned and analyzed 12K retail orders in SQL (DuckDB), building KPIs and monthly revenue trends
Identified Q4 seasonality and top category/region revenue drivers through segmented SQL analysis
Compared Online vs In-Store channel performance over time, isolating Online as the main seasonal-lift driver
Quantified discount-band effects on order volume vs order value to inform promotion strategy

projects.name: Customer Segmentation — RFM + K-Means
bullets: Engineered RFM features from 20K+ transactions and segmented 2,200 customers with K-Means clustering
Selected cluster count using elbow and silhouette methods, profiling four actionable customer segments
Mapped each segment to a retention or win-back action, concentrating spend on high-value customers

projects.name: AI Document Intelligence Platform — RAG & Agent Service
bullets: Built a RAG service on ChromaDB with Hugging Face embeddings, document chunking, and duplicate detection
Designed a tool-routing agent over vector search and SQL analytics, with swappable Ollama/Groq/OpenAI backends
Shipped a FastAPI REST API, containerized with Docker and deployed via a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline
Built a full-stack web interface (HTML/CSS/JavaScript) that calls the FastAPI backend for a complete request-to-response flow

projects.name: Retrieval-Augmented Q&A Service
bullets: Built an end-to-end RAG system (LangChain, LangGraph, ChromaDB): ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector indexing
Engineered semantic retrieval with grounded, source-attributed LLM responses across Groq, Ollama, LM Studio
Built a Streamlit app with document management, SHA-256 duplicate detection, and multi-turn conversations

projects.name: Grid Operations Agent — Agentic AI on a Lakehouse
bullets: Built a PySpark medallion pipeline (bronze/silver/gold) on Delta Lake/Databricks with z-score anomaly detection
Developed a CrewAI multi-agent crew (analyst, forecaster, reporter) over the gold tables with swappable LLM backends
Deployed the FastAPI service to Kubernetes with autoscaling and health probes, backed by an 11-test CI suite

projects.name: JobPilot-AI
bullets: Built an end-to-end automation system orchestrating a six-stage pipeline (search → match → apply) using LangGraph and Python
Engineered a resume-matching system that scores variants against a job description using structured LLM output (Gemini + Pydantic)
Automated live form filling with Playwright and integrated the Greenhouse API to pull postings and log applications to Excel

projects.name: Sales Analytics MCP Server
bullets: Built a Model Context Protocol server exposing 5 analytics tools an LLM calls to answer from real query results
Secured the SQL tool against the LLM as an untrusted caller, blocking all write/injection attempts (6 tests)
Split tool logic from the protocol layer for full testability (16 passing tests)

projects.name: PySpark Event ETL Pipeline
bullets: Built a PySpark ETL pipeline on a bronze/silver/gold architecture, processing ~62K daily events into analytics-ready tables
Added schema enforcement, window-function deduplication, and a data-quality quarantine for invalid rows
Orchestrated with an Airflow DAG whose retention gate fails bad runs, covered by 5 SparkSession tests

projects.name: Text-to-Image Generation Studio — Diffusion & FastAPI Service
bullets: Built a text-to-image service on Stable Diffusion (Hugging Face) with style presets, negative prompts, and seed-based reproducibility
Decoupled the diffusion engine from the API with lazy loading, enabling an 18-test GPU-free CI suite (GitHub Actions)
Served it via a FastAPI and Streamlit UI, containerized with Docker and device-aware across CUDA/MPS/CPU

projects.name: Demand Forecasting — Time Series
bullets: Built a SARIMA model on 3 years of daily demand, decomposing trend and weekly/annual seasonality into explicit model terms
Benchmarked against a seasonal-naive baseline on held-out data, cutting MAE ~14% to prove the model earned its complexity
Validated out-of-sample accuracy with MAE and MAPE on a held-out 60-day test period rather than reporting error in isolation

projects.name: Churn Prediction, End-to-End ML Service
bullets: Built an end-to-end churn service (pipeline, model, API) with a calibrated Random Forest at PR-AUC 0.51 vs a 0.21 base rate
Calibrated probabilities via isotonic regression (Brier 0.180 → 0.139) and set a cost-based threshold cutting cost 14%
Served the model behind a FastAPI endpoint returning probability, risk band, and an outreach flag, with automated tests

projects.name: Marketing Channel Experimentation & Propensity Targeting
bullets: Ran a two-proportion z-test on 41K contacts: cellular converted 2.4× higher than telephone (14.0% vs 5.7%, p < 0.001)
Built an XGBoost propensity model (AUC 0.70); top decile converted at 29% vs an 11% base rate — a 2.7× lift
Automated cleaning through significance testing, with a negative-control test that rejects a scrambled (null) effect
